section: Abstract
job_statement: When I need to scale pipeline infrastructure horizontally, I want to distribute pipeline workloads across multiple clusters, so I can overcome resource contention and handle increased capacity demands.
desired_outcomes: Minimize resource contention on API server and etcd
Reduce impact of cluster failures
Increase overall pipeline capacity
evidence: modules/op-about-multicluster-support.adoc, lines 63-67, abstract section describing multicluster capability
notes: Source: assembly abstract. Main job representing the core business need for multicluster support.

section: About multicluster support in OpenShift Pipelines
job_statement: When I experience performance degradation from running many concurrent pipeline tasks, I want to understand how multicluster architecture addresses resource bottlenecks, so I can decide if this approach fits my needs.
desired_outcomes: Minimize time to evaluate architectural options
Reduce likelihood of choosing wrong scaling approach
Ensure understanding of multicluster benefits and tradeoffs
evidence: modules/op-about-multicluster-support.adoc, lines 90-116, concept section explaining benefits and workflow
notes: Source: modules/op-about-multicluster-support.adoc (CONCEPT). Main job focused on evaluation and understanding.
